name: Staff of Swarming Insects
description: A gnarled staff riddled with tiny tunnels that buzz when it is shaken.
attuned_by: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

Its charges call up insects, giant ones or a plague of small ones, or a cloud of them that swarms around you, blocking sight.

## Charges

It holds ten and regains 1d6 + 4 each dawn. Spend the last and the insects may eat the staff.

features.name: Swarm
features.text: 1 charge: a swarm fills a 30-foot sphere around you for 10 minutes, heavily obscuring it, though not for you.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 a swarm consumes the staff and disperses
